items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Old Barron Man Bryan said, 'Sam, I see that you can duplicate yourself...'

ctx.x: And then Johnny and them, one day, Old Barron Man Bryan said, "Sam, I see that you can duplicate yourself, and you have done better. I was betting that you couldn't do it the second time. But you've done it and you've done it better." Which it was different, but I still don't realize the word 'sound'. I don't know about that yet, see?
This is, in a way of speaking, a fluke. And I've hit on something that I really don't know I'm on, see?
